new_finding.title: Operational proof-condition amplification in binary series arithmetic
new_finding.mechanism: seriesAlign installs A AND B; seriesBinary persists A AND (A AND B). Scalar promotion additionally reuses the left domain as the right domain.
new_finding.new_evidence: Native predicate counts 2^(n+1)-1 with a fixed independent zero series; 3^n with scalar zero; merge-only candidate remains 2^n; normalized join candidate constant on selected controls.

General profiling/caching of proof and normalization calls is not re-proposed; duplicate-free predicate propagation is a specific local invariant and code change.
Mathics mutual recursion between sign and realness helpers is a different mechanism. CG-01 is reproduced on Wolfram 15 and originates in shared metadata construction.
